channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Vietnam property market set for supply rebound, limiting price upside: VinaCapital
item.description: Vietnam’s property market is expected to enter a phase of rising supply in 2026–27, easing pressure built up over years of shortages and making a fresh price boom unlikely, investment firm VinaCapital said in a strategy report.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City approves $1.9bn investment in Cai Mep Ha port complex
item.description: The Ho Chi Minh City People’s Committee has given a nod to the Cai Mep Ha general and container port project, with a total investment of over VND50.8 trillion (US$1.97 billion).

item.title: Swiftlet farming emerges as new competitive advantage for Ho Chi Minh City’s Can Gio
item.description: Beyond its reputation as the ‘green lung’ of Ho Chi Minh City, Can Gio is gradually asserting another distinctive economic value through swiftlet farming closely linked to its mangrove ecosystem.

item.title: Americans expected to bet $1.76 billion on Super Bowl, AGA says
item.description: A record $1.76 billion will be legally wagered in the United States on next week's Super Bowl match-up between the Seattle Seahawks and New England Patriots, the American Gaming Association said on Friday.

item.title: Vietnam’s Gia Lai seeks tourism promotion partnership with CNN
item.description: Vietnam’s Central Highlands province of Gia Lai is seeking to promote its tourism internationally through a partnership with U.S.-based broadcaster CNN, provincial authorities said on Friday.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City launches comprehensive review of school meals over safety concerns
item.description: The Ho Chi Minh City Department of Education and Training ordered on Friday a comprehensive review of school meal programs, following reports that a food supplier used products that did not meet safety standards.

item.title: More than 200 killed in coltan mine collapse in east Congo, official says
item.description: More than 200 people were killed this week in a collapse at the Rubaya coltan mine in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Lumumba Kambere Muyisa, spokesperson for the rebel-appointed governor of the province where the mine is located, told Reuters on Friday.

item.title: Vietnam positioned as EU’s strategic anchor in ASEAN: ambassador
item.description: The elevation of EU-Vietnam relations to a comprehensive strategic partnership comes at an important moment.

item.title: Vietnam eyes $45–46bn in monthly exports in 2026 amid global headwinds
item.description: Vietnam aims to lift exports to about US$45–46 billion a month in 2026, equivalent to $546–550 billion for the year, as it seeks to sustain double-digit trade growth despite geopolitical tensions, tariff risks, and domestic climate shocks, the Ministry of Industry and Trade said on Thursday.

item.title: India's wealthy embrace a new luxury symbol: water
item.description: NEW DELHI, India - At an Indian gourmet food store, Avanti Mehta is organising a blind tasting of drinks sourced from France, Italy and India. No, this isn't wine, it's water.
